question: Who makes Da Gama Avocado Oils company
markdown:
Da Gama Avocado Oils
are produced by
Da Gama Avocado Oil Ltd
(also known as Da Gama Oils), an independent processing company based in White River, Mpumalanga, South Africa.
Company Details
Location:
White River, South Africa
Operations:
It operates as a pioneer and major global bulk and retail producer of food-grade edible avocado oil, alongside related products like macadamia oil, guacamole, and pastes.
Leadership:
Historically led by CEO Koos de la Rey.
